setup: DROP VIEW IF EXISTS barsql_golden.customer_totals
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS barsql_golden.orders
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS barsql_golden.customers
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS barsql_golden.items
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS barsql_golden.with_tax
DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS barsql_golden.count_orders
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS barsql_golden
CREATE SCHEMA barsql_golden

CREATE TABLE barsql_golden.customers (
    id int IDENTITY(1, 1) CONSTRAINT pk_customers PRIMARY KEY,
    email nvarchar(255) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_customers_email UNIQUE,
    name nvarchar(100) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT df_customers_name DEFAULT N'anon',
    created_at datetime2(3) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT df_customers_created DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(),
    CONSTRAINT ck_customers_name CHECK (LEN(name) > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE barsql_golden.orders (
    id int NOT NULL CONSTRAINT pk_orders PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id int NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_orders_customer REFERENCES barsql_golden.customers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    total decimal(10, 2) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT df_orders_total DEFAULT 0,
    status varchar(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT df_orders_status DEFAULT 'new',
    total_with_tax AS (total * 1.2) PERSISTED,
    note nvarchar(max) NULL
)
CREATE INDEX ix_orders_customer ON barsql_golden.orders (customer_id) INCLUDE (total)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_orders_status ON barsql_golden.orders (customer_id, status) WHERE status <> 'cancelled'

CREATE VIEW barsql_golden.customer_totals AS SELECT c.id, c.email, COALESCE(SUM(o.total), 0) AS total FROM barsql_golden.customers c LEFT JOIN barsql_golden.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.email
CREATE TRIGGER barsql_golden.orders_touch ON barsql_golden.orders AFTER INSERT AS UPDATE o SET status = LOWER(o.status) FROM barsql_golden.orders o JOIN inserted i ON i.id = o.id
CREATE FUNCTION barsql_golden.with_tax(@total decimal(10, 2)) RETURNS decimal(12, 2) AS BEGIN RETURN @total * 1.2 END
CREATE PROCEDURE barsql_golden.count_orders @status varchar(20) AS SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM barsql_golden.orders WHERE status = @status
